clips.title: The story
paras: At Westbrook Garrison, Deputy Rainer's few guards hold Elwynn's western road against gnolls and bandits. The outpost is short on soldiers and supplies, with danger rising near the Westfall border.

Westbrook Garrison watches the road where Elwynn Forest thins toward Westfall. Deputy Rainer and a handful of guards patrol the western roads with too few soldiers to cover them. Much of the Stormwind Army serves abroad, while political indecision in the capital leaves the outpost without needed support. Thieves grow bolder, and Riverpaw gnolls have overrun the southern woods. Marshal Dughan in Goldshire has not sent formal reinforcements, so the guards depend on travelers to help secure the highway.

Riverpaw gnolls gather south of Forest's Edge, where their raids threaten supply lines and homesteads. The packs follow Hogger, a fearsome chieftain whose forces outnumber the garrison and overwhelm its guards with brute strength. A high bounty is posted across the outpost, seeking fighters willing to enter the hills and bring down Hogger before the gnolls press farther east.
